_comment: The LANA engine folder the client packages at <resources>/engine (electron-local-engine.js), built by scripts/build-engine.js from this LANA-AI commit with the backend's scripts/release/build-engine-bundle.js on a matching computer, its node_modules installed with npm ci. treeSha256 is sha256 over one line per file (path, bytes, sha256), engine-manifest.json left out. Change the commit only together with a rebuild of every platform's entry. 0d9a94aae (2026-11-23): local first per request (a busy or failed local Pip goes to the box's Forge or Forge; Retry after a stop runs remote; data API 1.38). macos-arm64 built on the Apple-chip build Mac; macos-x64 and windows-x64 must be rebuilt on their own computers before those installers can be built.
